title: Understanding Exponential Regularization
text: Exponential regularization involves penalizing large values of theta by raising them to a power. This can help prevent overfitting by discouraging overly complex models. Consider how changing lambda affects the penalty applied to the model parameters.

title: Cross-Validation Insight
text: Cross-validation helps in assessing how the results of a statistical analysis will generalize to an independent data set. It is particularly useful in choosing the best lambda by comparing the root-mean square error across different folds.

title: Analyzing RMSE Values
text: Which lambda value results in the lowest average root-mean square error across the $$5$$ folds?

title: Effect of Lambda on Model Complexity
text: A smaller lambda value generally allows for more complex models, while a larger lambda value imposes a stronger penalty on large theta values, leading to simpler models. Think about how this affects the model's performance on unseen data.
